map.以随机模拟传统起卦流程生成本卦与变卦并给出卦象译注，属传统文化娱乐演示，非算命。: Randomly simulate the traditional hexagram-casting process to generate the primary and changed hexagrams with annotation—a traditional-culture entertainment demo, not fortune-telling.
map.起卦：默念所问，用三枚铜钱摇六次（或数字/时间法）得六爻阴阳，自下而上排成本卦。: Cast: focus on your question, toss three coins six times (or use a number/time method) to get six lines' yin/yang, arrange bottom-up into the primary hexagram.
map.定变卦：以“老阳变阴、老阴变阳”定动爻，生成变卦，本卦表现状、变卦表趋势。: Determine the changed hexagram: 'old yang → yin, old yin → yang' sets moving lines, generating the changed hexagram; the primary shows current state, the changed shows the trend.
map.解卦：依动爻数（0~6）查对应爻辞/卦辞规则，结合卦象解读给出象数层面参考。: Interpret: by the number of moving lines (0~6) apply the corresponding line/hexagram-statement rules, with hexagram-image reading for a symbol-number level reference.
map.以大衍之数五十起卦步骤: Casting steps with 'the great expansion, fifty'
map.：古法“大衍之数五十，其用四十有九”：分二、挂一、揲四、归奇为一易，三易（三变）: : the ancient method 'the great expansion is fifty, its use forty-nine': divide into two, set aside one, count by fours, and group the remainder as one change; three changes make one line (remainders 36/32/28/24 correspond to old yang 9 / young yin 8 / young yang 7 / old yin 6; 36 and 24 are moving lines). Repeat three changes × six lines to get six lines; old yang (9) → yin, old yin (6) → yang, yielding the primary and changed hexagrams. The tool simulates this uniformly at random, for traditional-culture entertainment reference.
map.本卦和变卦分别是什么意思？: What do the primary and changed hexagrams mean?
map.本卦（未变之卦）反映所问之事的当下状态；变卦由动爻阴阳反转得到，反映事态演变趋势: The primary hexagram (unchanged) reflects the current state of the matter; the changed hexagram, from reversing the moving lines' polarity, reflects the trend. With no moving line (static hexagram), read only the primary's statement; with moving lines, apply the rule by their count (see the Zhouyi Guaci tool).
